post.description: Atomically replaces both complete real-name fields of the confirmed person. Requires institution.corrections, a current normal administrator, and exact Origin; any supplied Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin. Current account targets must have a strictly lower institutional level. An identical original operation returns its permanent result before new target/version checks; altered confirmed input returns request_mismatch. Sessions, mobile and roles are unchanged. Changing the ID number of a person with a current account appends an Account projection and advances its state; a name-only correction leaves Account state unchanged. No account is created for a person without one, and a cancelled Account tombstone is unchanged.

delete.description: Revokes exactly one other effective session of the authenticated account. Rejects the acting session with 409 current_session. Foreign, unknown, expired and revoked targets uniformly return 404 resource_not_found. Locks and rechecks the actor, account and target before deciding. The operation binds the exact target; original recovery uses GET /revocations with scope other and the fixed singleton revocations set. Success preserves the acting session and never clears a cookie. Website requires exact Origin; Bearer is exclusive with website credentials.

get.description: Read the currently selectable directory for badge applicants and managers in one three-second read-only snapshot. Requires a normal account and current unsuspended Workforce membership, but no domain permission. Enabled groups, departments with fully enabled lineage, enabled roster entries and positions for those departments, and the enabled title tree are ordered by index then id; positions are ordered by department id, entry index then entry id. Every configured rule retains its department reference and reports whether that default is currently selectable; missing subtype codes are explicit. Disabled items, enabled flags and creation operation ids are not returned. Missing referenced rows are dependency failures, not empty selections. No query or body is accepted. Origin must match when supplied; absent Origin requires Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin. Any supplied Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin. No cookie is set.

get.description: Read the complete position list configured for one real department, including disabled entries and disabled positions, ordered by index then entry id. Lists are not inherited from parent departments. A missing department, or a group id in its place, returns 404 target_unavailable. Requires a normal, unsuspended current member with workforce.directory. Permission and the list share a three-second read-only snapshot. Invalid department ids return 400 invalid_input before authentication. No query or body is accepted. Origin must match when supplied; absent Origin requires Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin. Any supplied Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin. No cookie is set.

200.description: Complete department position list

put.description: Compare the complete expected list and replace the department's complete position list in one transaction. expected lists every current entry with id, positionId, enabled and index; replacement lists positionId, enabled and index for every position the department keeps or adds. List order does not matter; a position or entry appearing twice returns 422 invalid_input. Retained positions keep their entry id, new positions receive one and omitted positions are removed. Department and position references never change. Disabled departments and disabled positions may be configured; later selection checks their state. An already matching replacement appends a completion without changing configuration; other stale expected lists return data_changed. A missing department or replacement position returns target_unavailable. Retained matching operations return the current list, or deleted:true when the department was later deleted, without applying again; different input for the operation returns request_mismatch. Requires a normal, unsuspended current member with workforce.directory and exact Origin. No query is accepted and no cookie is set.

200.description: Current complete department position list or deleted:true

head.description: Read the complete position list configured for one real department, including disabled entries and disabled positions, ordered by index then entry id. Invalid department ids return 400 invalid_input before authentication. No query or body is accepted. Origin must match when supplied; absent Origin requires Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin. get.description: Read the entire management collection, including disabled items, ordered by index then id. Requires a normal, unsuspended current member with workforce.directory. Current permission and items share a three-second read-only snapshot. Groups, departments, positions, categories, disciplines and titles are delivered; other collection values return 400 invalid_input. No query or body is accepted. Origin must match when supplied; absent Origin requires Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin. Any supplied Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin. No cookie is set.

200.description: Complete collection selected by the path

post.description: Create a group, department, position, title category, discipline or complete title. Explicit name, enabled and index are required; departments also require groupId and accept an absent or null parentId for a top-level department; disciplines require a real categoryId and titles a real disciplineId. Names are NFC, trimmed, 1-64 Unicode scalars without controls, case-sensitive and unique across their applicable name scope (groups and departments share one scope; positions have an independent second scope; categories, disciplines and titles share a third scope), including disabled items. Requires current workforce.directory and exact Origin. No query is accepted. Matching Operation-Id returns the current original item or deleted:true without recreating it. Other input for a retained operation returns request_mismatch. No cookie is set.

201.description: Current original item from the path collection or deleted:true

head.description: Read the entire management collection, including disabled items, ordered by index then id. Requires a normal, unsuspended current member with workforce.directory. Current permission and items share a three-second read-only snapshot. Groups, departments, positions, categories, disciplines and titles are delivered; other collection values return 400 invalid_input. No query or body is accepted. Origin must match when supplied; absent Origin requires Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin. Any supplied Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin. No cookie is set.

200.description: Complete collection selected by the path

put.description: Compare the complete expected item and replace its mutable fields; id and creation operationId must remain unchanged. A department move changes the whole subtree atomically, with same-group parents and no cycles. A discipline may move to another real category and a title to another real discipline; a missing parent returns target_unavailable. An already matching replacement completes without changing configuration; other stale input returns data_changed. Retained matching operations return the current item or deleted:true without applying again. Requires current workforce.directory and exact Origin. No query is accepted and no cookie is set.

200.description: Current item from the path collection or deleted:true

delete.description: Delete an unreferenced item without children after comparing its complete expected value. A new request for an already absent item returns 404 target_unavailable; retained matching operations replay their completion, including deleted:true. Requires a normal, unsuspended current member with workforce.directory and exact Origin. No query is accepted and no cookie is set.

200.description: deleted:true
